inflation_floor_m.estimator: Mirte narrow-corridor floor. Must stay STRICTLY ABOVE the footprint's padded inscribed radius (0.140 + footprint_padding 0.01 = 0.150), or the inflation layer stops marking the band the robot's body occupies and the robot drives into obstacles despite a correct footprint. 0.20 is also the largest value that still leaves a passable channel in the ~0.84m lab corridor. Tiago's 0.325 pinned inflation to 0.25-0.30 and left MPPI no low-cost path; 0.12 and 0.15 were below the inscribed radius and unsafe.
